eligibility_rule: All selected Uber rows are eligible.
interpretation_note: A row can count as a trip even when it is ineligible for another metric.

eligibility_rule: Both timestamps present and elapsed time between 0 and 60 minutes inclusive.
interpretation_note: Use the precise label Request-to-Pickup Time; it may include scheduled-trip behavior.
Timestamp duration is used for QC; a mismatch over 60 seconds is flagged, not deleted.

eligibility_rule: trip_miles > 0 for averages and denominator-based metrics.
interpretation_note: Long trips above 50 or 100 miles are retained as genuine long-tail observations and flagged.

definition: Eligible miles divided by eligible official trip hours.
eligibility_rule: Eligible trip duration and eligible distance.
interpretation_note: Speeds above 60, 80, and 100 mph remain in the data and are monitored in quality output.

definition: Sum of reported base_passenger_fare, including rare negative adjustments.
interpretation_note: Passenger base fare excludes tolls, tips, taxes, and fees; it is not platform revenue.

definition: Average reported base_passenger_fare among eligible trips.
interpretation_note: Negative values remain in reported totals but are excluded from distribution and rate metrics.

definition: Sum of reported driver_pay, including rare negative adjustments.
interpretation_note: Driver compensation is analyzed separately from passenger fare.

definition: Average reported driver_pay among eligible trips.
interpretation_note: Do not infer platform margin or take rate by subtracting this from passenger fare.

definition: Sum of eligible base fare divided by sum of miles on the same eligible trips.
interpretation_note: A ratio of sums is used so very short trips do not dominate the metric.

definition: Sum of eligible driver pay divided by sum of miles on the same eligible trips.
interpretation_note: A ratio of sums is used so very short trips do not dominate the metric.

definition: Sum of eligible driver pay divided by official in-trip hours on the same trips.
interpretation_note: This is occupied-trip compensation intensity, not driver online-hour earnings or utilization.

definition: One row per pickup_date and PULocationID.
eligibility_rule: Pickup zone is between 1 and 265 inclusive.
interpretation_note: Invalid-zone coverage is retained in data_quality_by_month.

definition: One row per month, ISO weekday, pickup hour, and PULocationID.
eligibility_rule: Pickup zone is between 1 and 265 inclusive.
interpretation_note: This is a recurring month/weekday/hour profile, not a single calendar-hour fact table.

definition: Eligible trip count divided by all Uber trips in the month, multiplied by 100.
eligibility_rule: Metric-specific rule shown in the corresponding definition.
interpretation_note: Coverage rates make exclusions auditable without deleting source rows.

definition: Population and chronological-integrity checks for on_scene_datetime.
interpretation_note: Not used as a core KPI because the public field definition has an accessibility-vehicle caveat.
